name: s1bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean shapes, lots of calm white space. Unbranded, no text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A calm harbour by the sea seen from the side with NO boats, NO ships and NO people: on the far left a short grey stone pier with a few bollards, far away on the horizon a small green island with two palm trees; flat bright blue sea water fills the whole bottom half of the picture with a few simple lighter blue wave lines, the water is a little darker blue near the bottom. The upper half of the picture is plain white paper (no sky colour) with two small white seagulls.
